description_en: Installs Cloud Assistant Agent on one or more ECS instances. You must restart the instances to complete the installation
description_zh: 调用InstallCloudAssistant为一台或多台ECS实例安装云助手Agent。需要重启实例来完成安装云助手Agent的操作
kebab_example: aliyun ecs install-cloud-assistant --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1iudwa5b1tqa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InstallCloudAssistant

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instances. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances. You can specify 1 to 50 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID列表。列表元素数量为1~50
parameters.name: instance_id
